baseline_definitions.degree_only: nonnegative edge variables and root-star degree constraints
baseline_definitions.h_relaxation: degree, root-triangle clique, and every simple odd-cycle constraint
baseline_definitions.full_matching: degree and every odd-root-vertex-set blossom constraint

skewness_ablation.construction: Q=I-(2/3)J is a symmetric orthogonal Householder matrix
skewness_ablation.conclusion: skewness is essential even after all degree constraints pass

sampling_boundary: The atlas is exhaustive only over unlabeled roots of order at most seven; the four nonuniform integer-weight vectors per graph are seeded stress cases, not a probability model over applications.
